description: This file defines OpenGL 4.2 entry point functions, including wrappers for various GL commands such as BindImageTexture, DrawArraysInstancedBaseInstance, and TexStorage3D. It includes validation, context management, and capture mechanisms.

methods.name: BindImageTexture
methods.description: Binds an image texture to a specified image unit, with validation and context management.

methods.name: DrawArraysInstancedBaseInstance
methods.description: Draws arrays with instancing and base instance offset, with validation.

methods.name: DrawElementsInstancedBaseInstance
methods.description: Draws elements with instancing and base instance offset, with validation.

methods.name: DrawElementsInstancedBaseVertexBaseInstance
methods.description: Draws elements with instancing, base vertex, and base instance, with validation.

methods.name: DrawTransformFeedbackInstanced
methods.description: Draws using transform feedback with instancing, with validation.

methods.name: DrawTransformFeedbackStreamInstanced
methods.description: Draws using transform feedback stream with instancing, with validation.

methods.name: GetActiveAtomicCounterBufferiv
methods.description: Retrieves information about an active atomic counter buffer, with validation.

methods.name: GetInternalformativ
methods.description: Retrieves internal format information, with validation.

methods.name: MemoryBarrier
methods.description: Inserts a memory barrier, with validation.

methods.name: TexStorage1D
methods.description: Specifies storage for a 1D texture, with validation.

methods.name: TexStorage2D
methods.description: Specifies storage for a 2D texture, with validation.

methods.name: TexStorage3D
methods.description: Specifies storage for a 3D texture, with validation.
